purpose: Test whether price reactions after causally observed SEC 10-Q/10-K filings continue after the next regular-session open. Separate non-crypto event-driven evidence lane; no prior technical-pattern status is inherited.

causal_event_clock.reaction_session: first regular US equity session whose 09:30 ET bar begins strictly after the SEC acceptance timestamp; same calendar day is allowed only when acceptance is before that 09:30 open
causal_event_clock.prior_close: 15:59 ET close of the immediately preceding eligible regular session
causal_event_clock.missing_data: Fail closed. No interpolation, forward fill, proxy ticker, event-time substitution, or price substitution.

normalization.sigma: sample standard deviation of the previous 20 eligible regular-session close-to-close log returns, using only observations ending before the reaction session

economics.no_spread_reconstruction_claim: Minute aggregates are a research proxy, not executable NBBO fills.

SEC_H1_FILING_GAP_CONT_INTRADAY.signal: direction = sign(reaction-session opening gap) after the frozen 0.50*sigma20 threshold
SEC_H1_FILING_GAP_CONT_INTRADAY.exit: 15:59 ET open on the reaction session

SEC_H2_FILING_GAP_CONT_3SESSION.signal: same frozen opening-gap direction and threshold as H1
SEC_H2_FILING_GAP_CONT_3SESSION.exit: 15:59 ET open on the third eligible regular session after the reaction session, where reaction session counts as session 1
SEC_H2_FILING_GAP_CONT_3SESSION.overlap_rule: If a later filing for the same ticker occurs while an earlier event position would still be open, the later event is ineligible. No cross-ticker overlap restriction.

promotion.D3: Survival does not establish persistent edge; it creates a new candidate ID eligible for independent-source replication or prospective future shadow.
